svg.title: EV targeting beat risk targeting in all 9 scenarios
svg.desc: Lift of EV targeting over risk targeting at a $25,000 budget. cost $25 at 20% success: +20.9% (+$65.3K); cost $25 at 30% success: +20.4% (+$98.0K); cost $25 at 40% success: +20.1% (+$131K); cost $50 at 20% success: +27.3% (+$47.7K); cost $50 at 30% success: +26.0% (+$71.5K); cost $50 at 40% success: +25.4% (+$95.3K); cost $100 at 20% success: +40.7% (+$35.1K); cost $100 at 30% success: +37.1% (+$52.6K); cost $100 at 40% success: +35.5% (+$70.1K). At the default scenario EV returned $346,314, risk $274,825, random $35,809.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Backtest · out-of-fold predictions against true labels · $25,000 budget
